fake_runtime.determinism: event IDs and receipt bytes are stable for identical input
fake_runtime.replay: same event is a no-op; conflicting event is rejected

native_runtime.reason: the repository cannot prove native process start, descendant enumeration, or physical stop
native_runtime.accepted_evidence: only an external adapter receipt bound to the registered attempt

limits: No qualification claim covers OS-level process killing.
A timeout or missing receipt remains UNKNOWN, never STOPPED.
An observer receipt is not independently proof of observer truthfulness or completeness.
The helper does not spawn, supervise, enumerate, or kill native agents.
